name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-yango-delivery
title: Yango Delivery MCP
description: MCP server for the Yango Delivery claims B2B API: price checks, delivery claims, courier tracking.

environmentVariables.name: YANGO_DELIVERY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth Bearer token from the delivery cabinet (Integration tab -> "Get token"). Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: YANGO_DELIVERY_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Accept-Language header value (required by most claim methods).

environmentVariables.name: YANGO_DELIVERY_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network for idempotent calls only).
